# Question and source

Compare dry-weight measurements among the documented `PlantGrowth` groups. Read `?PlantGrowth` and describe its provenance and design without inventing treatment meanings.

```{r}
data("PlantGrowth", package = "datasets")
tab <- aggregate(weight ~ group, PlantGrowth, mean)
knitr::kable(tab, digits = 2, caption = "Mean dry weight by group")
```

# Figure and analysis

```{r, fig.cap="Dry-weight distributions by group"}
boxplot(weight ~ group, PlantGrowth, xlab = "Group", ylab = "Dry weight")
fit <- aov(weight ~ group, PlantGrowth)
summary(fit)
TukeyHSD(fit)
```

# Diagnostics and interpretation

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(fit, which = 1)
plot(fit, which = 2)
```

There are `r nrow(PlantGrowth)` observations. Write your interpretation of group differences, uncertainty, residual diagnostics, and limits here before submission.
